views.front: The seat now has a continuous tailored edge and rounded corners without projecting black support tips.
views.rear: The original wraparound back and arm supports remain attached, with the corrected seat fitted inside the shell.
views.detail: Full-size inspection confirms a consistent, seated welt and quiet cover surface; the former corner puckers and buried piping are gone.
views.underside: The support pan is contained inside the cushion and the extended original column meets the seat assembly without the former gap.
views.clay: Clay confirms the coherent rounded rectangular cushion and continuous seam while preserving the original barrel-chair silhouette.
